description: This file defines the class DefaultToApiJsonSerializer, a generic helper class that implements the ToApiJsonSerializer interface. It provides methods to serialize Java objects, collections, and pages into JSON format, using Gson. The class uses dependency injection for other serializer helpers and supports settings for partial responses.

classes.name: DefaultToApiJsonSerializer
classes.description: A default implementation of the ToApiJsonSerializer interface that serializes Java objects to JSON using Gson, supporting collections, pages, and settings for partial responses.

methods.description: Serializes the given object using the CommandProcessingResultJsonSerializer.
